title: Abnormal cases on the network side

entities.name: Network-requested PDU session release procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the network to release a PDU session.

entities.name: Remote UE report procedure
entities.description: Procedure where UE sends REMOTE UE REPORT message to the network.

entities.name: REMOTE UE REPORT message
entities.description: Message sent by UE during remote UE report procedure.

entities.name: PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message
entities.description: Message sent by network during network-requested PDU session release procedure.

entities.name: 5GSM STATUS message
entities.description: Message sent by network to indicate 5GSM protocol status.

entities.name: PDU SESSION INACTIVE
entities.description: State of a PDU session when it is inactive.

entities.name: Collision of procedures
entities.description: Condition when network-requested PDU session release procedure and remote UE report procedure occur simultaneously for same PDU session.

entities.name: PDU session inactive condition
entities.description: Condition when PDU session ID in REMOTE UE REPORT message belongs to a PDU session in INACTIVE state.

entities.name: Abort remote UE report procedure
entities.description: SMF behavior to abort remote UE report procedure when collision occurs.

entities.name: Send 5GSM STATUS with cause #43
entities.description: SMF behavior to send 5GSM STATUS message with cause #43 when PDU session is inactive.

relations.description: Collision condition establishes the behavior to abort remote UE report procedure.
Collision condition guards the continuation of network-requested PDU session release procedure.
REMOTE UE REPORT message contains PDU session identity IE.
PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message contains PDU session identity IE.
PDU session inactive condition establishes the behavior to send 5GSM STATUS message.
PDU session inactive condition requires the PDU SESSION INACTIVE state.
5GSM STATUS message contains PDU session identity IE.
